caption: What if you lived on Mars? India got there first try: Mangalyaan entered Mars orbit on 24 September 2014, making India the first Asian nation to reach Mars. Step outside and you need a helmet, because the air is about 95% carbon dioxide and less than 1% as thick as Earth's. It averages around -60 °C, and polar nights drop to -128 °C. Gravity is only 38% of Earth's, so a 60 kg person reads about 23 kg on a scale. A Mars day lasts about 24 hours 40 minutes, a bonus 40 minutes every day. A Mars year is 687 Earth days, so if you're 20 here, you're about 10 there. And Olympus Mons, a giant volcano, stands over 2.5 times as tall as Everest. Plot twist: the Red Planet has blue sunsets. NASA's Curiosity rover filmed one in 2015, because Martian dust lets blue light through. Would YOU move to Mars? 👇
